I saved the draft to Hollis and replied to Anselm in his DM.

The draft is addressed to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com), with the subject "Quarrendon Freight Lines – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It says the proposed rate is $2,356 a seat, that the figure came from Dana, and that Anselm approved sharing it. Nothing has been sent; the draft is in his mailbox for him to check and send.

No separate approval was needed. Hollis isn't the account owner, so the rate needed Anselm's or June's sign-off, and Anselm gave it in his message. Hollis is at pemberline.com, so Ruth's approval for outside mail didn't apply. I didn't check the $2,356 figure against any other source; it's the number Anselm gave me.
